title: Warm Canadian Corn Casserole
description: A sweet and comforting Canadian dish featuring creamed corn, this casserole is perfect for a cold winter's night, and its ingredients are ayurvedic-tamasic-friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large paella pan, mix together the flour, sugar, and melted butter until well combined.
Add the crushed french fried onions to the pan and stir until they are evenly distributed.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs, milk, salt, and pepper.
Add the cream style corn to the bowl and stir until well combined.
Pour the corn mixture over the flour mixture in the paella pan.
Bake the casserole in the preheated oven for 35 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
Remove the casserole from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
